scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @openmirage/db build && pnpm build && mkdir -p coverage && node --experimental-test-coverage --test ./dist/*.test.js > coverage/node-test-coverage.txt 2>&1; status=$?; cat coverage/node-test-coverage.txt; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; node ../../scripts/check-changed-coverage.mjs --format node-test-coverage --report-file coverage/node-test-coverage.txt src/index.ts
